bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to housing; appropriating money for a grant to Isuroon for rental assistance and eviction prevention services; transferring money; requiring a report.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. TRANSFER; HOUSING DEVELOPMENT FUND.

$2,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is transferred from the general fund to the housing development fund. This is a onetime transfer.

Sec. 2. APPROPRIATION; HOUSING ASSISTANCE.

Subdivision 1.

Appropriation; rental assistance and eviction prevention.

$2,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the housing development fund to the commissioner of the Housing Finance Agency for a grant to Isuroon, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization, to provide rental assistance and eviction prevention services that are culturally responsive and targeted toward the needs of immigrant and refugee families.

Subd. 2.

Use of grant money.

The grant money must be used to provide:

(1) direct rent payments to landlords for Minnesota tenants with overdue rent;

(2) eviction prevention, mediation, and navigation services; and

(3) culturally responsive outreach and case management services.

Subd. 3.

Reporting requirements.

By December 15 each year until 2027, Isuroon must submit a report to the chairs and ranking minority members of the legislative committees with jurisdiction over housing finance and policy. The report must include:

(1) the number of families served;

(2) the total amount of rent assistance distributed; and

(3) the outcomes of eviction prevention efforts.
